preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of flavors in each test case is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The cost of each flavor is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a single integer.
The output is the minimum number of coins needed to pay for any flavor in exact change using only coins of 1, 2, and 3 burles.
